visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A pair of hands lifts the lid of a large mint-green gift box, revealing a silver-lettered 'YOU' logo on an inner cardboard panel. The background is a brightly lit indoor environment with warm wooden textures. The camera uses a close-up shot as the hands carefully manipulate the premium packaging material. (2) The hands remove a square central panel featuring the red YouTube logo, revealing a black-and-white checkered pattern underneath. The lighting is soft and even, highlighting the glossy texture of the board. The movement is deliberate as the camera tracks the removal of the panel from a top-down perspective. (3) The individual lifts the entire checkered surface, which appears to be a heavy board, revealing a hidden drawer underneath. Inside the drawer, several black, high-gloss chess pieces are nestled in custom-cut foam slots. The person’s hands grip the edges of the board firmly to manage its weight. (4) A man with short dark hair, wearing a grey sweatshirt, enters the frame in a medium shot. He picks up a black chess piece, examining its weight and craftsmanship. The setting shows a modern indoor space with minimalist furniture and warm ambient lighting in the background. (5) The man opens a white trifold letter and presents it to the camera. The letter contains printed text, a QR code, and various statistics about a channel's achievement. He holds the paper steady for the viewer to see the details clearly before the video ends with a blurry fade.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-frequency rustling of paper and cardboard as a box lid is lifted. An upbeat, energetic electronic pop track with a clear 4/4 drum beat and bright synth pads begins immediately. There are no vocals yet, but the music establishes a high-arousal celebratory mood. (2) A male speaker begins talking in Mandarin with an excited, high-pitched intonation. He expresses curiosity as the sound of a flat panel being moved creates a slight sliding friction noise. The BGM remains constant in volume and tempo underneath the speech. (3) A loud, low-frequency percussive thud occurs as a heavy board is lifted and placed down. This is followed by the sharp metallic clinking of chess pieces rattling in their storage slots. The speaker's voice rises in pitch, conveying surprise and realization. (4) The speaker's narrative continues at a fast pace, describing the item as a gift from YouTube. The clinking of pieces continues as he handles them. The music's rhythm synchronizes loosely with his excited delivery style, which remains loud and enunciated. (5) Audible paper rustling as a letter is unfolded. The speaker reads portions of the text with a proud, positive valence. The background music swells slightly towards the end before fading out alongside the speaker's final thanking remarks to his audience.
